E3-01.behavior: Single transition path is used by manual requests, automatic/scheduled workers, recovered journals, remote steps and cloud receipts. Immutable request identity and local CAS are checked, and execution/document revision, audit, transition, optional receipt and operation outcome commit atomically.

E3-02.behavior: Current principals, sessions, grants, team membership, original and current referenced resources, normal/degraded devices, published definitions and organization eligibility are validated; their revisions are checked again in the mutation transaction. Automatic/scheduled control requires published-policy identity. Historical read APIs check original resources.

E3-03.behavior: Reconciliation queries original command journal over actual DataTransfer gRPC or signed NATS owner request, validates provenance and immutable binding, and persists trusted/rejected evidence. Manual cancellation/reconciliation/resume use expected versions; unknown actions never resend automatically. StartedMS is durably claimed before lookup and preserved across duplicate delivery/restart. Cloud acceptance is HTTP202 and keeps execution state until edge receipts.

E3-07-control.behavior: Execution detail exposes allowed actions, original-source timeline, approvals, atomic transitions, actions, feedback provenance, operation request/start/result times and trace IDs. Actual OTLP span export joins persisted transitions and command evidence.
E3-07-control.frontend_owner: phase3 frontend; browser implementation and independent acceptance are outside this role
